name: rosetta-higher-order-functions
code:
use IO.Std.write_line

apply[T,U](f: (T) -> U, argument: T) -> U =>
    f(argument)

shout(text: string) -> string => "{text.to_upper_invariant()}!"

write_line(apply(shout, "hello"))
write_line(apply(text => "<{text}>", "hello"))
